SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q11. If the sum of the zeroes of the polynomial f(x) = 2x^3 - 3kx^2 + 4x - 5 is 6, then the value of k is:
(a) 2
(b) 4
(c) -2
(d) -4

Answer / Solution:
Sum of zeroes for ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d is -b/a
Here a=2, b=-3k
Sum = -(-3k)/2 = (3k)/2
Given (3k)/2 = 6 => 3k = 12 => k = 4
Answer: (b) 4
